description: Soft-revoke a share token minted via `share_file`. The public `/share/files/<token>` URL stops resolving immediately. Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked token returns `alreadyRevoked: true` without error. Editor role required. Gated behind FILES_SURFACE_ENABLED + per-user allowlist.

token_id.description: The share token id returned by `share_file` (NOT the `url` token). Same id appears in the `list_file_shares` response.

name: revoke_file_share
